name: NOC — Databricks Pipeline Status
description: NOC status board: Databricks pipeline run status (running / failed / success), run durations, and per-pipeline health. __ACCOUNT_ID__ is replaced with the New Relic account ID at plan time.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(databricks.pipeline.run.failed) AS failures FROM Metric FACET pipeline SINCE 15 minutes ago
SELECT average(databricks.pipeline.run.duration) AS avg_duration_sec FROM Metric FACET pipeline TIMESERIES SINCE 1 hour ago

SELECT latest(databricks.pipeline.run.failed) AS failures, latest(databricks.pipeline.run.duration) AS duration_sec, latest(databricks.pipeline.rows_processed) AS rows FROM Metric FACET pipeline, criticality, team SINCE 1 hour ago
